text: Pour upon us, O Lord, the spirit of Thy love, to make us of one heart, whom, by Thy tender mercy, Thou hast filled with Thy paschal sacrament. Through Our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, Who with Thee liveth and reigneth in the unity of the same Holy Spirit, God, world without end.
